complete_examples.text: By increasing the size of the far-field soil finite elements, the total degrees of freedom (DOFs) of the vehicle–track–soil system are reduced, significantly improving computational efficiency.

Finally, the method is applied to analyze soil vibrations, investigating the time- and frequency-domain characteristics of near- and far-field vibrations and quantitatively evaluating the effectiveness of different vibration isolation measures.
